description: This file defines a utility class 'ValueDumper' used for testing purposes within the MigraDoc rendering unit tests. It provides a method to output the internal field values of an object for inspection.

classes.name: ValueDumper
classes.description: A helper class for dumping object field values during unit tests.

methods.name: DumpValues
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the non-public, instance fields of an object, including their values.
